definitions.initiation_2016: uplift-and-heave gate open at some time in the replayed 2016 record; closed form r_e kept (h_peak - z_toe) > (gamma_bl_sub / gamma_w) D_bl
definitions.p_d: probability that an exit opened in 2016 would have produced a boil that was seen and recorded; weight 0 for a breach, 1 - p_d for an initiated survivor, 1 otherwise
definitions.kept: ADR-0050 factor: share of the exit gradient the drain leaves
definitions.pressure_factor: instantaneous toe overpressure divided by this factor
definitions.decomposition: no_exit: gate never opened; exit_held_by_resistance: opened, erosion head at the peak not above H_c; exit_held_only_by_duration: fails the same-head steady-state rule, survives the transient one; breach: transient failure
